land_deed.name: Land deeds
land_deed.notes: Expansion supply. No fixed coin price: bought from other players' roadside shops (1-403 coins each), as a 12-diamond packet, or found randomly.

mallet.name: Mallets
mallet.notes: Expansion supply; same ways to get as land deeds.

marker_stake.name: Marker stakes
marker_stake.notes: Expansion supply; same ways to get as land deeds.

expansion_permit.name: Expansion permits
expansion_permit.notes: Cannot be bought or sold (Wheel of Fortune, derby checkpoints, ...).

step.value: Decorations bought with coins cost more with every copy: copy k costs price + step x (k-1). The wikis word it as 'per purchase' (en), 'after every purchase' (ru), 'the more you buy' (de).

step_basis.value: Stored copies cannot be the reason a price drops: while any copy of a decoration is stored, no more of it can be bought, so at every purchase owned = placed. Not established: whether deleting a copy, or copies received for free (rewards), change the next price. step_basis 'copies_owned' is therefore an assumption.

flat_prices.value: Fruit trees, bushes and animal homes: the wiki pages say each copy costs the same ('N coins each', 'Each house costs N'). Diamond- and voucher-priced decorations have no step in any source.

expansion_supplies.value: Expansion supplies have no fixed shop price; plot costs in supplies are in data/maps.
